data.raw_text:
From Philippine Arena to Bangkok: Aiah's on the B NEW ERA Stage ✈️🔥

Let’s take a moment to appreciate what’s really happening here.

Aiah will perform with BINI at Philippine Arena on November 29 — one of the biggest concerts ever staged by a P-Pop group. And just a few hours later, she’s set to appear in Bangkok at Queen Sirikit National Convention Center for Becky Armstrong’s B NEW ERA concert.

Aiah will likely fly out overnight right after BINI’s show — a roughly 3½- to 4-hour flight from Manila to Bangkok.
She’ll have less than 24 hours between stages — performing in front of tens of thousands one night, then appearing in another country’s major arena the next.

For Aiah, it’s a gesture of pure support.
For Becky, it’s a reminder that her new era is surrounded by people who truly believe in her.
For fans — it’s history in motion. Two Southeast Asian queens, back-to-back concerts, one shared weekend of fire, faith, and friendship.

So when Aiah walks onto that Bangkok stage, remember: She didn’t just travel miles — she carried the spirit of sisterhood, hard work, and heart across the skies. 🌏✨

Thank you, @bini_aiah — and thank you, #Blooms — for making this moment even more special for Angels and for Becky. Your love and effort mean the world. 💐🔥
